Hahae!

phew! (joy and relief)

In this lexicon

  • phew!

    the recommended word · classical · Plaut. Ps. 1052: Hahae, nunc dēmum mī animus in tūtō est locō; Plaut. Truc. 209: Hahahae, requiēvī
